playstyle.identity: Shaco is a trickster assassin who deceives enemies with boxes and clones. He invades, ganks from unexpected angles, and creates chaos.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q blinks and goes invisible, backstab crits. W places a fear box (use for traps/clears). E throws a dagger that slows and executes low health. R creates a clone (explodes into boxes on death). AP Shaco uses boxes, AD uses Q assassination.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Shaco spikes at level 3 with ganking tools. Duskblade or AP items work. He's strong early with cheese and invades.

passive.name: Backstab
passive.summary: Attacks from behind deal bonus damage.
passive.details: Shaco's basic attacks and Two-Shiv Poison deal bonus damage when hitting enemies from behind.

abilities.name: Deceive
abilities.summary: Blink and become invisible; next attack crits from stealth.
abilities.details: Shaco blinks to a location and becomes invisible. His next basic attack is guaranteed to critically strike.

abilities.name: Jack In The Box
abilities.summary: Place an invisible box that fears and attacks enemies.
abilities.details: Shaco places a box that arms after a delay. When triggered, it fears and attacks nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Two-Shiv Poison
abilities.summary: Passive: autos slow. Active: throw a dagger that deals execute damage.
abilities.details: Passive: Auto attacks slow enemies. Active: Shaco throws a dagger that damages, slows, and deals bonus damage to low health targets.

abilities.name: Hallucinate
abilities.summary: Create a controllable clone; on death, it explodes into boxes.
abilities.details: Shaco becomes invisible briefly and creates a clone. The clone can be controlled and explodes into 3 boxes when killed, dealing damage and fearing enemies.
